aggregation: float64 delta FedAvg then float32 exports, offline mechanism distinct from live Flower backend
attack_budget: Every adaptive round trains all 15 poisoned/ordinary local endpoints and all 15 unmodified endpoints from the actual current defended base; only the three attacker exports are interpolated/extrapolated. Ten candidates per round. No unseen test data.
detector_inputs: Only current global/local models and frozen clean calibration; no attack identities or private rows are passed to residual_scores or policy.step.
information_budget: White-box frozen predictor/calibration and exact policy state; up to ten validation-ASR queries per round. This deliberately privileged attack search is not the blind detector input path.
interpretation: A finite pilot can demonstrate realizable evasion for the specified search budget; it cannot establish universal adaptive security or an infinite model trajectory.
selection: Require supported context and quorum. Prefer candidates whose three attackers are all currently permitted. At R1 maximize the minimum positive attacker envelope excess, then validation full-trigger ASR, then smaller alpha. At later rounds maximize the count of current-high attacker excesses suppressed by the historical episode peak, then validation full-trigger ASR, then smaller alpha. If no attacker-permitted candidate exists, minimize attacker quarantines before the same objective. If no supported quorum exists, halt and report.
